factProposals.value: A trainer schedules and holds sessions; staff take a knowledge check; vendor staff complete the TxDOT-approved cyber security programme.
The build counts a person as trained only when they pass the course knowledge check at 80% or more.

decisions.statement: Understanding is measured by a short knowledge check per course, not by attendance.
decisions.rationale: The acceptance asks that staff understand the functionality.

decisions.statement: A session cannot be marked held without a recording reference.
decisions.rationale: People who miss it must have the recording.

decisions.statement: Cyber security completion is stored on the person, so compliance checks can read it.
decisions.rationale: REQ-020 and the compliance rule CR-08.

limitations.statement: The workspace stores where the recording is kept; it does not record or host video.
The cyber security course here only records completion; the programme content is TxDOT's.
